alternatives_considered.approach: Truncate-with-ellipsis plus title on the headings, buttons, confirms, and notices instead of wrapping.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: ui.md reserves truncate for list rows; a heading, a Join button, or a confirm question truncated to an ellipsis stops saying which group or seat it acts on. PR #54 set the precedent the other way: rows truncate, headings and sentences that name a group or person wrap.

alternatives_considered.approach: Add break-words at each ConfirmStep and StateMessage call site instead of in the shared components.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because:
The call sites are byte-identical symptoms of one shared

each; per-site classes are N chances for the next caller to miss one. The one-place fix in components/ui.tsx covers the settle-up and expense delete confirms and notices too, which interpolate names with the same shape.

alternatives_considered.approach: Clip with max-width/overflow-hidden on the buttons and notices so nothing can widen the page.
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Clipping hides the name it is supposed to confirm (which seat am I claiming, what was added), trading a layout defect for a trust defect in a money app. Wrapping keeps the full name legible.

alternatives_considered.approach: Leave the expense-editor Remove-per-payer button and the /activity empty-state link out of this ticket as further follow-ups.

work_order.approach:
Apply the PR #54 overflow-wrap idiom to the five reported spots plus the two further instances of the same defect: block-level headings and sentences get break-words; anything that is a row-axis flex item gets a min-w-0 box of its own plus break-words, because a flex item's automatic minimum size is its min-content width and overflow-wrap alone cannot reduce it. Specifically: the join h1 gains break-words (block in a flex-col div, the group-page h1 precedent); the Join and claim button labels move into min-w-0 break-words spans with min-w-0 appended (not replacing ml-auto) on the buttons, the spans inside children so the pending-label path is untouched; the shared ConfirmStep question

gains break-words (it is always the only child of ConfirmStep's own flex-col box, so min-w-0 there would be inert) while StateMessage

gains min-w-0 break-words (min-w-0 is load-bearing where the message renders as an item of a flex-wrap row), one place covering all confirms and notices; ExpenseScreen gains break-words on h1/subtitle/bottom Back-to paragraph and min-w-0 break-words on the group-crumb

  • with an in-file comment recording the breadcrumb decision (this crumb is a link naming the group so it follows the members back-link wrapping precedent, while the current-page crumb beside it keeps truncate as a location); the expense-editor multi-payer Remove button gets the same label-span plus min-w-0 treatment; the /activity empty-state Open-group Link gains min-w-0 max-w-full break-words, where max-w-full is load-bearing in the items-start column. QA drives two accounts throughout because the join page redirects members and signed-out visitors, plus a third fresh account for the activity empty state. No copy, markup (beyond the three button-label spans), or behaviour change; rows and the shell keep truncate.
assumptions: Each of the five findings still reproduces on main: verified by reading the current code (no break-words/min-w-0 at any cited site) plus a headless-Chromium fixture pass replicating each site's exact markup and load-bearing ancestor CSS; the exact in-app scrollWidth numbers remain QA-measured per AC, so reproduced is true with the method disclosed here.
Tailwind break-words (overflow-wrap:break-word) plus min-w-0 behaves here as it did in PR #54, which QA verified at 375px in Chromium.
AppShell place={groupName} needs no change: it already renders truncate with the full value in title (components/app-shell.tsx:88-95).

GROUP_NAME_MAX and PLACEHOLDER_NAME_MAX are both 80, DESCRIPTION_MAX is 200 (lib/groups/validation.ts:21-22, lib/expenses/validation.ts:77), and user display names are capped at 80 (lib/auth/validation.ts:55-59); the 200-char unbroken description is the widest string the edit h1 can hold, and the expense subtitles naming the viewer display name are covered by the same paragraph-level break-words.

What keeps this out of the 90s: the browser numbers are of faithful fixtures of the markup, not full authenticated app flows, so QA's per-AC in-app scrollWidth reads remain the final proof, and the claim-button row's line-breaking can only be judged on the built app.

work_order.understanding: Issue #55 collects five leftover instances of one root cause PR #54 proved on the group and members pages: an up-to-80-character unbroken group or seat name (up to 200 for expense descriptions, up to 80 for user display names) rendered with no overflow-wrap treatment becomes a single unbreakable line that sets the document width at a 375px viewport.
